headline: Approved return of contributions for four members and retirement applications for two members; elected David Mount as Chair and Kyle Blake as Vice-Chair.
summary: The board approved the June 15, 2026 meeting minutes, return of contributions for four employees, and retirement applications for two employees. It held an executive session on actuarial services contract terms but took no action afterward, elected David Mount as Chair and Kyle Blake as Vice-Chair, and heard reports on the actuarial valuation and monthly investment performance.
decisions: Approved the June 15, 2026 Retirement Board Meeting Minutes, with two members abstaining.
Approved return of contributions for Nicholas J. Andrade ($28,216.70), Kimberly A. Rojas Cepeda ($3,658.22), Erik D. Ramakrishnan ($10,937.58), and Ann C. Reading ($13,080.99).
Approved retirement applications for Natalie Grant ($24.60) and Andrew A. Awhaitey ($1,139.62).
Held an executive session on contract terms for actuarial services; no action was taken after the session.
Elected David Mount as Chair and Kyle Blake as Vice-Chair of the Retirement Board.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Board Member Blake, seconded by Board Member Kasti, to approve the June 15, 2026 Retirement Board Meeting Minutes. Motion passed with Alan Matson and Ashley Parker abstaining.
Motion made by Board Member Schad, seconded by Board Member Kasti, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Blake, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
No action was taken after the executive session.

David Mount is now the Chair of the Retiremen Board.
Kyle Blake is now Vice-Chair of the Retirement Board.
